title: Mindless door: Continue or Start fresh for a practice with a partial today; the door's length survives a fresh start and a sub-mode change

source.ref: Mindless timer dig 2026-11-09, seam 3 and 4 in /mnt/project-files/mindless-timer/01-INVENTORY-AND-RESTORE-PLAN.md

detail: Both engines resumed a partial today silently: the door showed the full length controls, the member picked a number, and the run opened on the remaining minutes instead. The engine's own New Practice split button was unreachable once the door auto-started. The door now reads the practice's partialToday, locks the length to the remaining minutes with a Continue, N min left chip, and offers Start fresh beside it. Start fresh forwards fresh: true through the provider and the route door; both engines drop the partial for the launched practice so the chosen length runs from zero. In the sit, a sub-mode change no longer resets a length the member chose on the door to the sub-mode default.
